title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 14: King Asa's reforms, his fortified cities and his victory over Zerah the Ethiopian.

questions.text: For how many years was the land quiet in Asa's days?
questions.explanation: Asa reigned in his father's place, and in his days the land was quiet ten years.

questions.text: Besides taking away the foreign altars and high places, what did Asa cut down?
questions.explanation: Asa took away the foreign altars and high places, broke down the pillars and cut down the Asherah poles.

answers.text: The olive trees of the priests

questions.text: Why did Asa say the land was still before them?
questions.explanation: Asa said, "The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahweh our God."

answers.text: Because their army was very large
Because they had paid tribute to Syria
Because the walls were already built
Because they had sought Yahweh their God

questions.text: What did the men from Benjamin in Asa's army carry?
questions.explanation: Two hundred eighty thousand from Benjamin bore shields and drew bows.

questions.text: Who came out against Judah with an army of a million troops?
questions.explanation: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots.

questions.text: How many chariots did Zerah bring?
questions.explanation: Zerah came with a million troops and three hundred chariots.

questions.text: In which valley did Asa set the battle in array?
questions.explanation: They set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

questions.text: How did Asa begin his prayer to Yahweh before the battle?
questions.explanation: Asa cried, "Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength."

answers.text: "Yahweh, give me the necks of my enemies"
"Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help"

questions.text: How far did Asa and the people pursue the Ethiopians?
questions.explanation: Asa and the people with him pursued them to Gerar.

questions.text: What did they carry away from the tents of livestock before returning to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They struck the tents of livestock and carried away sheep in abundance and camels.
